name: Koi Suru Kimochi no Kasanekata
original_name: 恋する気持ちのかさねかた
source:
Starting next spring, adjacent schools Seiou Gakuen and Shiraba Gakuen will merge at the same time of the marriage between their respective chairmen. One day, Seiou student Ren and the student council leader Saori were asked by the chairman Rin to find out any worries that the students have about the merger. They immediately enlisted the help of the Shiraba student council leader Yukie and began to ask the students of both schools.

They each had their own worries: the closure of the student dormitory, the elimination of smaller clubs, an emotional attachment to their school, no longer able to chase after their dreams, family matters, and much more. Ren offers his hand in helping the girls with their worries and they happen to end up living together as ‘lovers’.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/11/26/november-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
从明年春天开始，相邻学校圣王学园和白羽学园将在各自董事长结婚的同时合并。有一天，凛会长向圣王学生莲和学生会长纱织询问学生们对于合并的担忧。他们立即得到了白羽学生会长由纪惠的帮助，开始向两所学校的学生询问。

他们各自有自己的烦恼：学生宿舍的关闭、小社团的解散、对学校的依恋、无法追寻的梦想、家庭的问题等等。任出手帮助女孩们解决烦恼，最终她们以“恋人”的身份生活在一起。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/11/26/november-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
